settings.label: Property ID
settings.meaning: The property (the site) the chat widget belongs to.
settings.whereToFind: Administration › Overview: the Property ID, below the property image. Tawk.to has no test mode: use a separate property for test.

settings.label: Widget ID
settings.meaning: Which of the property's chat widgets the pages show.
settings.whereToFind: Administration › Chat Widget: the Widget ID under Widget Status (the last part of the Direct Chat Link).

settings.label: JavaScript API key
settings.meaning: Signs the signed-in user's id, so the widget knows who is chatting and nobody can claim to be someone else (Secure Mode).
settings.whereToFind: Administration › Overview › JavaScript API: turn on Secure Mode and copy the key beside it. Each property has its own.

settings.label: Webhook secret key
settings.meaning: Checks that a webhook came from Tawk.to.
settings.whereToFind: In the dashboard's Administration section, under Webhooks: create a webhook with the app's URL and its events, then copy its secret key. Each webhook has its own.

operations.name: visitor.login
operations.purpose: Signs the visitor in, in the browser: Tawk_API.login with the app's user id and the hex HMAC-SHA256 of that id keyed with the JavaScript API key, plus name, email and custom attributes. Restores the user's earlier conversations. Tawk.to has no server API for visitors or contacts.

operations.name: visitor.logout
operations.purpose: Signs the visitor out, in the browser: Tawk_API.logout.

operations.name: events.add
operations.purpose: Records a custom event on the visitor's chat, in the browser: Tawk_API.addEvent(name, metadata). The name is letters, digits and dashes. Tawk.to has no server API for events.

signature.description: The header is the hex HMAC-SHA1 of the raw request body, keyed with the webhook's secret key, with no prefix and no timestamp. X-Hook-Event-Id names the event and stays the same across retries, but isn't signed.

events.meaning: The first message of a chat was sent, by the visitor or an agent.
A chat ended, and its full transcript is in the body.
